name: 🏢 社区中心
desc: 开放时间·会员卡·泳池·课程报名·陪同规定·订场·活动·押金·志愿者·收费

items.en: The community centre opens at ten.
items.zh: 社区中心十点开门。

items.en: Please register for a membership card.
items.zh: 请办理一张会员卡。

items.en: The swimming pool reopens tomorrow morning.
items.zh: 泳池明天早上重新开放。

items.en: Please register at the reception desk.
items.zh: 请到接待台登记。

items.en: The yoga class begins at seven.
items.zh: 瑜伽课七点开始。

items.en: Please pay the deposit in advance.
items.zh: 请提前支付押金。

items.en: We welcome volunteers every weekend.
items.zh: 我们每个周末都欢迎志愿者。

items.en: The swimming pool is closed on Mondays for regular maintenance.
items.zh: 泳池每周一关闭做常规维护。

items.en: Sign up for the evening cooking class at the reception desk.
items.zh: 请到接待台报名晚间烹饪课。

items.en: Children under six must be accompanied by an adult.
items.zh: 六岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

items.en: You can reserve the main hall online after ten tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天十点后你可以在线预订主厅。
chunks: You can reserve the main hall

items.en: Your membership includes free access to every class.
items.zh: 你的会员资格包含每门课程的免费使用权。

items.en: The deposit will be refunded within seven business days.
items.zh: 押金将在七个工作日内退还。

items.en: The weekend craft activity is completely free for members.
items.zh: 周末的手工活动对会员完全免费。

items.en: If you want to reserve the main hall, please pay a refundable deposit in advance.
items.zh: 如果你想预订主厅，请提前支付一笔可退押金。
chunks: If you want to reserve the main hall

items.en: Volunteers who help at our events will receive free entry to every class.
items.zh: 在活动中帮忙的志愿者将获得每门课程的免费入场资格。
chunks: Volunteers who help at our events

items.en: If you are not a member yet, you can still join today's afternoon guided tour.
items.zh: 如果你还不是会员，仍然可以参加今天下午的导览。
chunks: If you are not a member yet

items.en: When the swimming pool gets crowded, please limit your session to one single hour.
items.zh: 当泳池拥挤时，请把游泳时段控制在一小时以内。
chunks: When the swimming pool gets crowded

items.en: The weekend cooking class that fills up fast usually needs an early reservation.
items.zh: 很快满员的周末烹饪课通常需要提前预约。
chunks: The weekend cooking class that fills up fast
skeleton: 很快满员的周末烹饪课

items.en: Because the main hall is very popular this month, please reserve your preferred date early.
items.zh: 由于本月主厅非常抢手，请尽早预订你心仪的日期。
chunks: Because the main hall is very popular this month

items.en: If your membership expires this month, you can renew it at the reception desk today.
items.zh: 如果你的会员卡本月到期，今天就可以在接待台续费。
chunks: If your membership expires this month
